review:
Two Wazdan series mixed together: the retro Hot Slot look and the Coins bonus. It plays on 15 reels with two paylines for regular wins, and special Hot Slot symbols add extra rewards.

Cash Infinity symbols show up as sticky red symbols that stay on and make the bonus more likely. Hold the Jackpot tops out at a 3,000x Grand. High volatility, 96.18% RTP. A good pick if you like Coins games but want more going on between bonuses.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Free demo available on the Wazdan website
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
